data.description:
Das Unternehmen

Die Bendl Investment GmbH ist ein inhabergeführtes Multi Family Office und Vermögensverwaltung mit Sitz in Erding. Wir betreuen Unternehmer, Führungskräfte, Erben und vermögende Familien in den Bereichen Vermögensanlage, Altersvorsorge, Absicherung und langfristige Finanzplanung.

Unsere Arbeit beruht auf einer wissenschaftlich fundierten Anlagephilosophie, festgelegten Beratungsprozessen und einer sorgfältigen Dokumentation. Die Zusammenarbeit mit unseren Mandanten ist langfristig angelegt.

Ihr Aufgabengebiet

Nach der Einarbeitung übernehmen Sie die operative Wertpapierabwicklung nach festgelegten Prozessen.

Orderabwicklung und Sparpläne

  • Vorbereitung und Abwicklung von Wertpapierkäufen und -verkäufen

  • Einrichtung, Änderung und Kontrolle von Sparplänen

  • Überwachung vereinbarter Sparplandynamiken

Modellportfolios

  • Technische Umsetzung beschlossener Änderungen der Modellportfolios

  • Pflege und Kontrolle der Modellportfolios in den eingesetzten Systemen

Unterlagen, Kontrolle und Dokumentation

  • Vorbereitung erforderlicher Antrags- und Auftragsunterlagen

  • Nachbearbeitung eingereichter Vorgänge

  • Kontrolle der vollständigen und korrekten Ausführung

  • Anforderung fehlender Kundenunterlagen und Nachhalten offener Vorgänge

  • Vollständige und nachvollziehbare Dokumentation

Abgrenzung der Position

Die Tätigkeit ist operativ ausführend und kontrollierend. Anlage- und Beratungsentscheidungen trifft ausschließlich die Finanzberatung. Anlageberatung und die inhaltliche Mandantenbetreuung sind nicht Bestandteil der Position. Ein Vorgang gilt als abgeschlossen, wenn er korrekt ausgeführt, kontrolliert und dokumentiert ist.

Ihr Profil

  • Berufserfahrung bei Bank, Sparkasse, Vermögensverwaltung, Finanzdienstleister, Maklerpool oder im Wertpapier-Backoffice

  • Kenntnisse in Wertpapier- und Depotprozessen

  • Sehr sorgfältige und gewissenhafte Arbeitsweise

  • Hohe Zuverlässigkeit und Freude an strukturierten Abläufen

  • Sicherer Umgang mit digitalen Anwendungen

  • Absolute Vertraulichkeit im Umgang mit Kunden- und Finanzdaten

  • Bereitschaft, Vorgänge vollständig bis zum Abschluss zu bearbeiten

  • Wiedereinstieg nach einer beruflichen Pause oder Tätigkeit mit reduzierter Stundenzahl ausdrücklich willkommen

Unser Angebot

  • Langfristig angelegter Minijob mit fachlich anspruchsvollem Aufgabenbereich

  • Arbeitszeiten nach Vereinbarung

  • Strukturierte Einarbeitung in Abläufe und Systeme

  • Klar definierter Aufgabenbereich mit dokumentierten Abläufen

  • Arbeitsplatz im Büro in Erding, kleines Team

  • Vergütung entsprechend Ihrer Erfahrung

Ihre Bewerbung

Bitte senden Sie uns eine kurze Bewerbung mit Lebenslauf und relevanten Zeugnissen unter Angabe Ihres möglichen Eintrittstermins.

data.description:
Das Unternehmen

Die Bendl Investment GmbH ist ein inhabergeführtes Multi Family Office und Vermögensverwaltung mit Sitz in Erding. Wir betreuen Unternehmer, Führungskräfte, Erben und vermögende Familien in den Bereichen Vermögensanlage, Altersvorsorge, Absicherung und langfristige Finanzplanung.
Unsere Arbeit beruht auf einer wissenschaftlich fundierten Anlagephilosophie, festgelegten Beratungsprozessen und einer sorgfältigen Dokumentation. Die Zusammenarbeit mit unseren Mandanten ist langfristig angelegt.
Im Rahmen unseres Multi-Family-Office-Service übernehmen wir für ausgewählte Mandanten administrative Aufgaben rund um deren Vermögen und Immobilien. Für diesen Bereich suchen wir Verstärkung in der Sachbearbeitung.

Ihr Aufgabengebiet

Sondereigentumsverwaltung (eigene Immobilien und Immobilien von Mandanten)

  • Schriftliche und telefonische Kommunikation mit Mietern und Hausverwaltungen

  • Prüfung und Erfassung eingehender Korrespondenz

  • Beauftragung und Koordination von Handwerkern und Dienstleistern nach Freigabe

  • Nachhalten beauftragter Reparaturen bis zur Erledigung

  • Überwachung von Terminen und Fristen

  • Prüfung und Vorbereitung von Abrechnungen und Unterlagen

  • Strukturierte Ablage und Dokumentation

Mandantenadministration

  • Sichtung und Erfassung eingehender finanzieller Korrespondenz ausgewählter Mandanten

  • Schriftverkehr mit Banken, Versicherungen, Hausverwaltungen und weiteren Dienstleistern

  • Anforderung fehlender Informationen und Dokumente sowie Weiterleitung erforderlicher Unterlagen

  • Vorbereitung von Vorgängen zur Bearbeitung durch die Finanzberater

  • Überwachung von Fristen und Nachhalten offener Vorgänge bis zum Abschluss

  • Ablage und strukturierte Verwaltung der Unterlagen

Abgrenzung der Position

Die Tätigkeit ist kaufmännisch-administrativ ausgerichtet. Inhaltliche, finanzielle und rechtliche Entscheidungen trifft ausschließlich die Finanzberatung bzw. die Geschäftsführung. Beratende Aufgaben gegenüber Mandanten sowie technische oder Hausmeistertätigkeiten sind nicht Bestandteil der Position.

Ihr Profil

  • Kaufmännische Ausbildung und/oder Berufserfahrung in Haus- oder Immobilienverwaltung, Bank, Versicherung, Steuerkanzlei, Rechtsanwalts- oder Notariatskanzlei, kaufmännischer Verwaltung oder Sekretariat

  • Sicherer Umgang mit Dokumenten und Schriftverkehr

  • Sehr sorgfältige und strukturierte Arbeitsweise

  • Absolute Zuverlässigkeit und Diskretion

  • Gutes kaufmännisches Verständnis

  • Sicherer Umgang mit digitalen Anwendungen

  • Fähigkeit, fehlende Informationen nach festgelegten Vorgaben einzuholen und Vorgänge vollständig abzuschließen

Unser Angebot

  • Langfristig angelegter Minijob

  • Arbeitszeiten nach Vereinbarung

  • Strukturierte Einarbeitung in Abläufe und Systeme

  • Klar definierter Aufgabenbereich

  • Arbeitsplatz im Büro in Erding, kleines Team

  • Vergütung entsprechend Ihrer Erfahrung

data.description:
Account Executive - Enterprise - DACH

 

Munich or Berlin

Language requirement: Fluency in both German & English

 

Wordsmith

Wordsmith is building the legal operations platform for in-house teams, and we are growing fast.

We believe in-house legal is becoming one of the most important functions in the AI era. Every business is moving faster, but legal work is still too often scattered across inboxes, chats, documents, and disconnected systems.

Wordsmith brings that work into one system. Requests come in from across the business, AI agents handle the routine, lawyers stay in control where judgment matters, and every step is captured as work happens.

We are built for in-house legal, not law firms. Our goal is to help legal teams move faster, reduce unnecessary external counsel spend, and become a function the business can run with.

More than 500 companies, including Financial Times, Safelite, Trip.com, Canva, Starling, and Sage, use Wordsmith. Backed by $100M from Index Ventures, General Catalyst, Highland Europe, and others, we are building one of the defining companies in legal AI.

 

The Role

We’re hiring an Enterprise Account Executive - DACH to lead complex, high-value deals across large organisations across the DACH region.

You’ll be responsible for building and progressing a focused set of strategic opportunities. This means navigating multiple stakeholders, building internal champions, and creating alignment across legal, technical, and commercial teams.

You’ll work closely with Legal Engineers, Product, and Leadership, but you own the deal strategy and the outcome.

 

What you’ll do

  • Own a portfolio of high-value, enterprise opportunities

  • Build and execute deal strategies across complex buying groups

  • Navigate stakeholders across Legal, Finance, Security, IT, and Procurement

  • Develop strong champions and drive internal alignment within accounts

  • Lead longer sales cycles (6–12+ months) with clear structure and momentum

  • Partner closely with GTM Legal Engineers on solution design

  • Maintain accurate forecasting and clear deal visibility

 

What we’re looking for

  • Experience closing complex enterprise SaaS deals

  • Fluent in both German and English

  • Track record of landing and expanding high-value accounts

  • Strong stakeholder management across multiple functions

  • Ability to build champions and navigate internal politics

  • Structured, strategic approach to deal management

  • High ownership and accountability for outcomes

 

How we work

We’re an in-office team. We work together because it makes us faster, sharper, and more effective. You should expect to be in the office our out visiting clients as your default.

This is a high performance environment. We set a high bar, move quickly, and expect people to take ownership of real problems.

There isn’t always a clear path. The people who do well here figure things out, stay close to the work, and keep pushing until they get to the right outcome.

This role requires patience, structure, and strong judgement. You’ll be trusted to run complex deals with a high degree of autonomy.

 

Why Wordsmith

We’re in a period of strong momentum — growing quickly, winning new customers, and expanding into larger accounts.

The product is landing well, the market is ready, and the team is scaling to meet demand.

If you want to be in the room, close meaningful deals, and grow quickly in a high bar environment, this is one of the best places to do it.

data.description:
Your Impact

Procurement is over 50% of revenue for industrial companies and their biggest lever for profitability. The hard part is not the software, it is that every customer's reality is different: a different ERP, a different data model, decades of undocumented process. Generic platforms stall exactly there, and that is where most enterprise AI value quietly dies.

Forward Deployed Engineering is how we close that gap. You sit inside the customer's environment, build in their production data, and turn what you learn there into product. You are one of the first FDEs at Tacto, so you are not slotting into a playbook, you are writing it while shipping in real accounts.

Your Tasks

Build in customer environments. Data pipelines, agents, and custom logic on top of the Tacto platform, in real production data.

Own the technical side of a deployment. Extraction, mapping, validation, enrichment, until the customer's procurement team can actually work with the result.

Be in the room, on site. Run data workshops with key users, debug alongside their IT, and see how a company really buys instead of how the process documentation says it buys.

Turn what you learn at the edge into product. Document the pattern and push it to Product and Engineering instead of quietly rebuilding the same one-off for the next customer.

Automate your own job. If a step in a deployment can be done by an agent, you build the agent and prove it works.

Make it one team. Hold the boundary with Solution Engineering and Customer Value so the customer experiences one Tacto, not three.

Your Profile

  • You are a builder. You have shipped software, automations, agents, or technical projects that real users relied on.

  • You write code yourself. You are comfortable with Python and SQL and use AI coding tools to move fast.

  • You are AI-native. You have built with LLMs against real data and understand where agents work, where they fail, and where humans still matter.

  • You thrive in messy environments. Incomplete requirements, undocumented data, and conflicting stakeholder input do not stop you from making progress.

  • You can earn customer trust. You explain technical decisions clearly, handle pushback, and do not over-promise.

  • You have 0-4 years of experience with evidence of a steep learning curve through strong technical work, ambitious startups, internships, or things you built from zero.

  • You speak native-level German and fluent English, are based in Munich, and are willing to travel regularly across DACH.

Why This Role is Awesome

You get to combine building software with seeing exactly how it creates value in the real world. You will ship into production, work directly with industrial customers, and turn what you learn at the edge into product improvements. Do this well for 12 to 18 months and you are among the people who defined what Forward Deployed Engineering means at Tacto, with a direct line into the product roadmap and an obvious next step, whether that is leading a team, going deeper into product, or owning a segment.

What This Role Is, and Isn't

We want to be honest about what you are signing up for.

  • This is not an engineering role with customers kept at a safe distance. Customer contact is the job, not a tax on the job. If you want a ticket queue and clean requirements, this is the wrong role.

  • This is not consulting. Nobody here bills days. You are measured on what the customer can do afterwards and on what made it into the platform.

  • It is deliberately broad. If you want to specialise narrowly you will be frustrated here.

  • The deal: prove yourself, deliver real impact, make a strong case for yourself, then we back your next step in every way we can.

Why Tacto

We bet on young talent and mean it. We consistently back smart, hungry, young people with real ownership early. 70%+ of our Leadership Team was promoted internally: you deliver impact and sky is the limit at Tacto.

Backed to win big. We are Sequoia and Index-funded with €50M+ behind us. Our founders sit at the same table as the people defining the global AI agenda. We're building Tacto to be the lighthouse for European industrial AI.

A truly AI-native organization, with every resource you could dream of. All the leading AI tools and custom agents at your fingertips, plus dedicated people who keep us at the frontier.

High bar, high speed, genuinely fun. You'll be surrounded by extremely smart and ambitious people who set the bar high and push you to get better every week. Intense, fast, and the opposite of boring.

A front-row seat in the European startup ecosystem. Weekly exposure to leading founders and operators through internal and external events (Lunch & Learns, hackathons, community gatherings). Check out all upcoming and past events here: https://luma.com/tacto

You'll build something that lasts and that matters. You'll help build the company that keeps European industry competitive for the long term.

Our Background

Tacto is building the intelligence layer that connects AI to the physical world of manufacturing, starting with procurement. AI is transforming every industry, but it stops at the factory gate. The knowledge that holds manufacturing together - part costs, suppliers, materials - is scattered across systems and people. Over 50% of a product's cost originates from suppliers, making procurement the single largest cost lever in manufacturing and the missing connection between the digital and the physical world. Yet it still runs on Excel and legacy systems. We're changing that with our Procurement Intelligence Platform, trusted by hundreds of companies running billions of Euros of material.

Based in Munich, we are 100+ passionate builders who are in-office, with high expectations, fast growth, and a lot of fun. We are supported by >€50m from Sequoia, Index, and Europe's leading tech entrepreneurs and industry veterans.

Why It Matters

Manufacturing forms Europe's economic backbone, driving a fourth of Europe's GDP and providing over 30% of jobs. These hidden champions and global market leaders manufacture the physical world around us, from the machines that build our cities to the medical devices that save lives.

But the world is changing. The US dominates the digital world of bits. China is scaling the world of atoms, manufacturing at unprecedented speed and scale. Geopolitics are more uncertain than ever. Europe's strength lies in its deep industrial knowledge through generations of engineering. Manufacturing worldwide runs on European machines and software. But that heritage is only an advantage if we leverage it in the age of AI.

Tacto builds the AI that connects Atoms and Bits, empowering our Industrial Base to Stay Stronger and building a lighthouse for European tech.

What We Offer

The people at Tacto are passionate about building the organization, growing themselves, and our product while having fun and being real. We have high expectations, great talent density, and a culture where your ambition, performance, and agency are what count - not where you come from or how big your ego is. You'll grow at the forefront of AI, have real ownership and impact, and be surrounded by the best people in their field who challenge you and make you better every day. That is demanding and rewarding, but that's where we thrive. Besides that you have:

  • Money: Competitive salary & equity in the company with real upside, so you are invested in our success

  • Workplace: A vibrant in-office culture (> 4 days/week) in a beautiful office in central Munich

  • Development: A development budget and regular exposure to exceptional people, e.g., Lunch & Learns, peer mentoring, external speakers

  • Time off: 26 + 4 vacation days per year (4 fixed “company rest days”) as well as regular off-sites and team events

  • Health: Wellpass membership, of course, a fruit basket (!), and access to Jobrad, for your health

  • Family & Social Security: Voluntary pension contribution, voluntary KITA subsidy for your children

Tacto is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, religion, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, or gender identity. Please do not submit personal data revealing racial or ethnic origin, political opinions, religious or philosophical beliefs, trade union membership, data concerning your health, or data concerning your sexual orientation.

Few people get to build a bank from scratch. Even fewer get to build one at a moment when banking itself is being reinvented.


The Dollar is the best product in the history of the world - there is infinite global demand. But International Fintechs and non-US banks are left with two unsatisfying options to access it: Either they build on legacy clearing banks that are slow and unreliable, or they interface with middleware providers that don’t move and hold the dollars directly, but themselves rely on underlying legacy banks. Augustus collapses this stack by combining two things: A real, national bank charter (in organization), and Marble, our proprietary core banking system, built around intelligence, made of code.


We are a group of operators, unicorn early employees, ex-founders and people who walked away from degrees because they believe this is an industry and career defining opportunity. We are backed with more than $200M from Peter Thiel's Valar Ventures, Tiger Global, Hummingbird, QED, Creandum, and the founders of Nubank, Ramp, Deel, Circle, Fluidstack, Fuse, and n8n.


We are regulated in Europe and live with Euro and Stablecoin clearing today. Now, we are building the US team from the ground up, while continuing to grow rapidly in Europe.

The Role

You will own security engineering end-to-end across application, infrastructure, and incident response: partnering with product and platform teams during design, writing and shipping security automation in production, and leading high-quality response when something breaks. Day to day, you will help define security in a greenfield modern bank, moving beyond threat modeling, harden cloud and CI/CD paths, build detection and response workflows, and drive remediation to closure with clear risk tradeoffs. This role reports to the CISO. What matters most is measurable risk reduction that keeps product velocity high.

 

Your First Six Months

Understand the foundations and increase your ownership rapidly.

  • Months 1-2: Enforce an SSDLC that codifies existing security goals across EU-live payment/ledger services and US launch-critical services into required design, build, and release checkpoints (ownership, control evidence, and exception handling), with 100% of net-new Tier-1 changes following the workflow.

  • Months 3-4: Stand up an AI-native product-security review pipeline that auto-triages code/dependency/IaC findings by service criticality, proposes fixes in pull requests, and routes owner-tagged remediation tasks and reduces non-actionable security alerts.

  • Months 5-6: Expand baseline coverage to >=85% of Tier-1 services for workload identity hardening, secret management standards, runtime audit logging, and high-severity dependency monitoring; start monthly control-evidence reporting to Security & Compliance.

Who Will Thrive At Augustus

We believe that throwing smart people with high agency at big problems produces the best outcomes. The people who succeed here share the following traits:

  • Relentless: You can't leave something broken. You don't stop because it got hard or because no one is watching.

  • Set The Bar: You're harder on yourself than anyone else would be. You don't need external accountability to care about quality.

  • Shape The Game: You don't wait for a playbook and you don't need one. You walk into genuinely new territory and figure it out. You move before anyone asked you to.

  • Systems First: You don't solve problems by adding people or effort. You build systems that make the problem smaller. Your first instinct is to automate, not to handle it manually.

 

This role is for you if:

  • You can point to security automation you personally built that replaced recurring manual review work.

  • You have strong product security fundamentals and can improve secure-by-default patterns in fast-moving engineering teams.

  • You have led end-to-end rollout of security controls in production, from design and implementation through adoption and evidence.

  • You regularly influence architecture decisions before launch through fast, lightweight risk reviews and pragmatic controls.

  • You are comfortable writing production-grade code or infrastructure changes, not only policy or tickets.

  • You use AI tooling to accelerate security reviews and remediation planning without lowering quality or signal.

  • You push ambiguous work forward without waiting for a complete playbook, and you bring stakeholders with you.

This is not for you if:

  • You prefer advisory-only security roles and do not want direct implementation ownership.

  • You need tightly scoped tickets to make progress and are uncomfortable defining the plan yourself.

  • You avoid ownership of production systems and control implementation work.

  • You optimize for stability over change and are not excited by early-stage ambiguity.

 

Hard Requirements

  • Extensive experience in hands-on security engineering, product security, cloud security, or detection/response engineering in production environments

  • Demonstrated expertise securing cloud-based systems (IAM, networking, logging, key management, workload isolation) and CI/CD pipelines

  • Proven experience building at least one security automation or detection capability that is actively used in production

  • Experience in fintech, payments, banking, or another regulated environment with audit and control evidence requirements

  • Experience with modern security tooling, especially SIEM/SOAR and cloud security platforms

  • Located in (or willing to relocate to) Berlin and able to work in-office 3 days/week

 

Pay transparency

Compensation packages at Augustus include base salary, equity, and benefits. New hire offers are made based on a candidate's experience, expertise and geographic location. The annual base salary range for this role is €100,000-€150,000 + equity.

What We Offer

  • Career Growth: You will be given more responsibility and pushed to grow faster than ever before.

  • Network: Your peers are brilliant, highly motivated people. These people will be foundational in your future opportunities.

  • Real Participation: Employees are shareholders. You will think and act like an owner.

  • Perks & Benefits: Relocation support, visa support, the latest Apple gear (MacBook + AirPods), lunch benefit, gym benefit, a beautiful office in the heart of the city, 4x on-/offsites per year, and an annual development budget.

Additional to the global benefits above, we offer localized benefits such as comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance and a 401(k) retirement plan for our US team.

Augustus is committed to creating an inclusive environment where people from all backgrounds can thrive and where different viewpoints and experiences are valued and respected. Augustus will consider all applications for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, national origin, religious beliefs, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, neurodiversity, disability, age, parental or veteran status.

Deine Aufgaben:

Mission
Content für unsere Kunden entsteht bei yoursquares nicht mehr Stück für Stück, sondern über ein System, das du aufbaust. Sobald ein Creative bei einem Kunden zieht, lässt du daraus AI-gestützt binnen kurzer Zeit ein ganzes Set an Varianten entstehen – andere Hooks, neue Formate, kürzere und längere Schnitte – und bringst sie parallel in den jeweiligen Account. Jede Version bleibt klar auf die Marke des Kunden zugeschnitten, und was weiterläuft, entscheiden die Zahlen, nicht das Bauchgefühl.

Produktentwicklung & Workflows

  • Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit unserem Produkt-Team unseren AI-Creative-Stack weiter und gestaltest Systeme, mit denen wir deutlich mehr hochwertige Werbemittel in kürzerer Zeit produzieren können.

  • Du musst dabei nicht jeden technischen Prozess selbst programmieren oder bauen. Entscheidend ist, dass du verstehst, was mit AI, Automatisierungen und modernen Tools möglich ist, wo technische Grenzen liegen und wie ein sinnvoller Workflow aussehen sollte

  • Wenn du Workflows, Automatisierungen oder Prototypen selbst bauen kannst: umso besser. Bei komplexeren Lösungen arbeitest du eng mit unserem Produkt- und Tech-Team zusammen und bringst die fachlichen Anforderungen ein

Automatisierte Content-Produktion

  • Du arbeitest täglich mit Tools wie Claude Code & Design, Make, Higgsfield. HeyGen, Midjourney, Runway, Nano Banana, und weiteren AI-Tools und verbindest sie sinnvoll miteinander

  • Du entwickelst High-Performing Creatives für Paid Ads selbst – Static Ads, Video, Motion, Landingpages und neue Formate

  • Du analysierst unter anderem Hook Rate, CTR, Conversion Rate, CPL, CPA und ROAS und nutzt diese Erkenntnisse, um unsere Creative-Produktion kontinuierlich besser zu machen

Tooling, UX & Marktbeobachtung

  • Du gestaltest auch die UX/UI unserer internen AI-Tools und Workflows mit. Dein Anspruch: Komplexe Technologie muss so einfach werden, dass jede Person im Team sie intuitiv nutzen kann

  • Du beobachtest den AI-Markt kontinuierlich und erkennst früh, welche neuen Modelle, Tools und Workflows einen echten Vorteil bringen

  • Du testest neue Technologien schnell und pragmatisch. Wenn ein neues Tool unseren bestehenden Prozess deutlich verbessert, integrierst du es – statt an bestehenden Lösungen festzuhalten


Das bringst du idealerweise mit:

  • Du bringst mindestens 2 Jahre Erfahrung im Bereich Content, Creative, AI, Automation oder einem vergleichbaren digitalen Umfeld mit.

data.description:
Your mission

As our Quality Assurance Engineer (Software), you will help ensure the quality, reliability and usability of ProGlove’s connected solutions across embedded and IoT devices, mobile applications, front-end experiences and back-end services.

You will take ownership of quality assurance within the team, combining thoughtful manual testing with effective automation. By challenging assumptions, investigating complex system behavior and continuously improving how we test, you will help us deliver dependable products to our customers.

In this role, you will:

  • Take ownership of QA processes within the team and champion quality throughout the product development lifecycle.
  • Analyze end-to-end system architectures, user flows and integrations to identify risks and gaps in test coverage.
  • Create clear and concise test plans based on product and technical requirements and document them in TestRail.
  • Plan and execute functional, regression, API, integration and cross-platform testing.
  • Contribute to our automation frameworks by designing and implementing new automated tests and maintaining existing test suites.
  • Perform hands-on manual and exploratory testing where it adds value.
  • Configure and maintain dedicated test environments and test data and support performance and load testing when required.
  • Share findings transparently, raise risks early and collaborate with engineers and other stakeholders to resolve issues.
  • Continuously improve our testing approaches, tools and ways of working.


Your profile

At ProGlove, technical expertise matter, but how you work is just as important. We are looking for someone who takes ownership, stays curious, collaborates openly and applies pragmatic judgment.

  • You bring 4+ years of relevant quality assurance experience, including at least 2 years of hands-on test automation experience.
  • You have experience building or contributing to automation frameworks and maintaining automated test suites.
  • You understand and can apply the full Software Testing Life Cycle, including functional, regression, API, integration and cross-platform testing.
  • You can analyze end-to-end architectures, user flows and integrations, identify quality risks and translate them into appropriate test coverage.
  • You have hands-on experience with automation tools  and frameworks such as Pytest, Cypress, Selenium, Appium or REST Assured.
  • You are comfortable configuring and maintaining test environments and test data.
  • You have experience executing performance or load tests.
  • You take end-to-end ownership, communicate clearly and raise risks early.
  • You enjoy investigating complex issues, challenging assumptions and balancing thoroughness with pragmatism.
  • You collaborate openly with engineers and other stakeholders.
  • You are fluent in English and comfortable working in an international environment.

Experience in one or more of the following areas would be valuable, but is not required:

  • Python or JavaScript and Git
  • UNIX or Linux environments
  • Agile product development environments
  • Test documentation tools, especially TestRail
  • AWS or other cloud platforms
  • Testing embedded systems, IoT devices, mobile applications or connected hardware ecosystems


Why us?

  • Diversity and inclusion: Diversity is core to us and one of the reasons for our success.
  • Career development: We support active and individual career planning and progression at your own pace.
  • Cutting-edge technology: Choose the devices that work best for you from our range of supported IT products.
  • Location-specific benefits: Benefit from offerings tailored to your location, such as gym membership, pension funding and mobility support.
  • ProHealth: Our global health program supports the physical and mental well-being of all team members.
  • Employee referral rewards: Earn €2,000 before tax by referring someone who joins our team.
  • Office events: In addition to our summer and winter parties, smaller office events are part of everyday life at ProGlove.


What success looks like

  • Quality risks are identified early, communicated clearly and addressed before they affect customers.
  • Critical user flows and integrations have reliable, risk-based test coverage across the relevant platforms and system components.
  • Automated test coverage grows in a maintainable way and supports faster, more confident releases.
  • Test plans, results and quality documentation are clear, current and useful to the relevant stakeholders.
  • QA is an active part of product development, with shared ownership of quality across the team.
  • Testing processes, environments and tools become more effective and scalable over time.


Meet your team

You will join our Quality Assurance team and work closely with software, embedded and mobile engineers, as well as other relevant stakeholders across Product and Engineering.

The team values hands-on collaboration, clear communication and shared ownership of product quality. You will contribute your perspective early in the development process, help the team understand quality risks and work together with colleagues to turn requirements and user flows into practical, maintainable test coverage.

Your mission

As our Product Manager – Android Integration & Ecosystem, you will define the product what and why for how ProGlove devices connect, integrate and create value within the enterprise Android ecosystem.

ProGlove is evolving from a wearable scanner company into a Worker Companion company, bringing together ergonomic wearable hardware, software, connectivity, workflow guidance, data and intelligence. With the MAI Wearable Companion, we are entering a broader ecosystem of enterprise applications, technologies, standards, partners and customer infrastructure.

Your mission will be to make our products easy to adopt, integrate and deploy at scale – without turning every customer opportunity into a bespoke engineering project. You will identify recurring customer needs, translate them into scalable capabilities and propositions, and decide where ProGlove should own, enable or partner. In doing so, you will help turn integration from a technical necessity into a source of differentiation, customer value and commercial opportunity.

You will work closely with the Product Manager responsible for the Wearable Companion device. While they own the device proposition, you will own how the device connects to and creates value in the wider ecosystem. Together, you will shape a coherent end-to-end proposition for customers, developers, integrators and partners.

Your day-to-day 
  • Define and evolve the product strategy and priorities for ProGlove’s enterprise Android integration and ecosystem capabilities, aligned with customer needs and business goals.
  • Work directly with customers, Sales and Solution Architecture to identify recurring problems, distinguish individual requests from broader market needs and turn the right opportunities into scalable solutions.
  • Translate recurring integration needs into repeatable product capabilities such as APIs, SDKs, tools, interfaces, documentation, integration patterns and deployment solutions.
  • Shape the product experience around device setup, provisioning, application distribution, device management and other capabilities required to deploy and operate connected device fleets at scale.
  • Make clear, pragmatic decisions about where ProGlove should own, enable or partner, balancing customer value, strategic control, speed, scalability and technical complexity.
  • Identify the platforms, applications, standards and ecosystem players that matter to our customers, and shape the integrations, certifications and technology partnerships that strengthen our proposition.
  • Explore where integration capabilities, software, services and ecosystem propositions can create differentiated value and support commercial or recurring-revenue opportunities.
  • Partner closely with Engineering and the Product Manager for the Wearable Companion to create alignment on customer problems, priorities, trade-offs and desired outcomes.
  • Enable Sales and other customer-facing teams to clearly explain our Android proposition, supported capabilities, integrations and common deployment patterns.
  • Maintain a forward-looking view of enterprise Android, AOSP, enterprise mobility, AI and adjacent technologies, and translate relevant developments into strategic options and product priorities.


Your profile

At ProGlove, technical expertise matters, but how you work is just as important. We are looking for someone who takes ownership, stays curious, collaborates openly and turns complexity into clear, pragmatic decisions.

  • You bring strong Product Management experience in B2B or enterprise technology and can define strategy, discover meaningful customer problems, prioritize opportunities and turn them into scalable products or propositions.
  • You are commercially minded and naturally connect product decisions with customer value, differentiation, business impact and opportunities to capture value.
  • You are comfortable working with enterprise software, platforms, connected devices, integrations or technology ecosystems, and understand the realities of complex customer IT environments.
  • You have enough technical depth to understand architecture, interfaces and trade-offs, contribute credibly to platform and integration discussions, and recognize when deeper engineering expertise is needed.
  • You think in systems and patterns: when faced with a customer requirement, you look beyond the immediate request to understand why it exists, how broadly it applies and what a simple, repeatable solution could look like.
  • You take end-to-end ownership, move topics forward without waiting for perfect instructions and remain effective when the product space or path ahead is not yet fully defined.
  • You collaborate generously and build trust across Product, Engineering, Sales, Solution Architecture, customers and external partners. You can create alignment and drive decisions without relying on formal authority.
  • You communicate clearly and transparently, raise risks early and can make complex technical and commercial topics understandable to different audiences.
  • You are curious about customers, the business and emerging technologies, and continuously test assumptions rather than pursuing technology for its own sake.
  • You use pragmatic judgment to balance speed, simplicity, quality and long-term value.
  • You are fluent in English and comfortable working in an international environment.

Experience in one or more of the following areas would be valuable, but is not required:

  • Enterprise Android, AOSP or adjacent Android ecosystems, including environments operating outside standard Google Mobile Services.
  • Enterprise mobility management, MDM/EMM, device provisioning, application deployment or connected fleet management.
  • Rugged or industrial devices, IoT or edge devices, connected hardware or other B2B technology ecosystems.
  • APIs, SDKs, developer or integrator experiences and enterprise integrations.
  • Platform or ecosystem strategy, technology partnerships, certification programs or developer and partner ecosystems.
  • Enterprise customers deploying technology at scale.

Over time, success will mean more than making our own products easier to integrate. It will mean creating capabilities, interfaces and ecosystem relationships that customers, application providers and partners actively choose to build around - moving ProGlove from ecosystem participant toward ecosystem shaper. 
If you are excited by the idea of turning complex technology ecosystems into simple, valuable products - and helping shape how the next generation of frontline technology connects with the digital world - we would love to meet you.

  • Customer-facing teams can confidently communicate our Android proposition and common deployment patterns without relying on Product or Engineering in every opportunity.
  • Relevant integrations, partnerships and commercial opportunities are identified, validated and translated into tangible product or business outcomes.


Meet your team

You will join our Product team and report directly to the CPO. You will work especially closely with the Product Manager responsible for the Wearable Companion, as well as colleagues across Engineering, Sales, Solution Architecture and Product Marketing.

This is a highly cross-functional role. Unsere regionalen Standorte („Hubs“) installieren Wärmepumpen bei Hausbesitzerinnen und Hausbesitzern; Prozesse, Kundenakquise, Recruiting und eigene Software kommen zentral aus unserem HQ in München.

Mit jeder Wärmepumpe, die wir installieren, wächst die Zahl unserer Kundinnen und Kunden, die auch nach der Installation gut betreut werden wollen. Rückfragen, Wartungen, kleine Störungen: Wie wir damit umgehen, entscheidet, ob jemand uns weiterempfiehlt.

data.description:
Your mission

Bookboost is the Hospitality Engagement Platform that empowers hotels to understand and engage their guests like never before. We unify guest data, automate personalised communication, and deliver experiences that drive revenue, loyalty, and operational excellence.

We have customers across more than 20 countries and a platform that wins on depth. We're now looking for a Full Stack Engineer to help us build the next stage of it.

Tech stack: Angular | TypeScript | Node.js | Cloudflare Workers | AWS | PostgreSQL | Terraform


Your profile

As a Full Stack Engineer you build and maintain the systems behind our platform: real-time data processing, the APIs that hold it together, and the experience our customers use every day.

The job is shifting from writing syntax to designing systems. We want engineers who are architects: people who define the right abstractions, shape the right interfaces, and make decisions that hold up six months later. Agents write a growing share of the code. Your value is in orchestrating intent, context and execution.

You would be joining a small engineering team with real latitude on technical direction. This is not a seat implementing someone else's design. If you want to be handed tickets and left alone, this is not that job. If you want a say in how the platform is built, it is a good one.

What you'll own and deliver

  • Scalable, high-performance applications across the stack
  • Frontend applications in Angular, with genuine attention to responsiveness and user experience
  • APIs designed with the rest of the team, focused on event-driven architecture and real-time data
  • Edge computing work using Cloudflare Workers, improving performance and deployment efficiency
  • Migration of services to edge runtimes, improving scalability and reducing latency
  • Architectural decisions that outlive the tickets that prompted them
  • Cross-functional work with design, product and Operations on what customers actually need
What makes you a great fit?
  • Full stack depth: 4+ years with modern frontend and backend technologies, and production systems you have owned rather than contributed to
  • Backend: strong in Node.js or another JavaScript runtime, and TypeScript. PHP and Laravel are a plus, not a requirement.
  • Data: relational databases, particularly PostgreSQL, including schema design and query optimisation
  • Frontend: modern frameworks, particularly Angular
  • Edge: familiarity with Cloudflare Workers and services such as Durable Objects, KV and Workflows, or other edge runtimes
  • Cloud: understanding of cloud architecture, particularly AWS
  • AI fluency: our engineering team runs on an AI-native stack. You write code and documentation with AI tools and can talk concretely about how that has changed the way you work. This is a genuine requirement, not a bonus line.
  • Systems thinking: root cause over band-aids, patterns over one-offs. You would rather fix the shape of a problem than patch it again.
  • Craft: you care about reliability, observability, testability and documentation
  • Language: fluent English. Swedish is not required.
What's in it for you?
  • Remote and flexible working, from home or one of our hubs
  • Real influence over technical direction at a company still deciding
  • An engineering team building new ways of working with AI rather than bolting it on
  • An environment that values your judgement, with real room for impact
  • Regular team events and socials


Why us?

Bookboost gives hotel groups ownership of their guest relationships. We unify guest data across the PMS, booking engine and every communication channel, then orchestrate the guest journey pre-stay, in-stay and post-stay. Based in Malmö, Sweden, with hubs in Amsterdam and Barcelona, we work in a hybrid, remote-friendly way. Diversity and innovation go hand in hand, and we are committed to an inclusive environment where everyone can do their best work.

Everyone is welcome at Bookboost
We value individuality and creativity, and we are building a team that reflects the world we serve. If you are passionate about making a difference, apply even if you do not meet every criterion.

Ready to join us?
Send us your application today. We interview on a rolling basis, so apply early.

ZeitMind, the autonomous data engineer for the European mid-market

About Zeit AI

In the coming years, companies will replace their internal data teams with AI agents to run more efficiently. We will be the solution they'll use. ZeitMind connects to the systems companies already run (ERP, CRM, spreadsheets, internal databases), cleans messy data, runs analyses on its own and builds data applications. Every employee can then work with data in plain language, with no technical degree and no help from IT. Our customers use it to organise agricultural inventories, to schedule maintenance, crew and flights for jet operators, and to replace controllers' manual Excel reports.. Founded by Marvin and Leopold, both ex-Palantir. YC S24, backed by Oxford Seed Fund and Sequoia Scout. Customers in manufacturing, agriculture and aviation. Zero to €1M ARR in our first twelve months with six people. Small team, one room in Munich, regular team offsites.

What This Role Is

At our size, every hire shapes the company, and the team we build over the next year will decide how far ZeitMind goes. That's why this role matters so much to us.

As our first People hire, you own how people join and grow at Zeit AI, from a candidate's first touchpoint to their first months on the team. You make hiring fast, personal and professional. You keep us compliant across Germany and the UK, and you build the People foundations we'll rely on at 20, 50 and 100 people. You work directly with Marvin and Leopold, shape the function from day one, and help make Zeit AI a place great people want to join and stay.

Your Daily Business - no two days are alike

  • Recruiting in Ashby, end to end: job postings, sourcing support, screening, scheduling interviews, collecting feedback and following up with candidates. No candidate waits a week for an answer

  • Comfortable hiring for both technical and non-technical roles. You can run a process for a senior engineer as confidently as for a sales or ops hire, and you know what good looks like in each

  • Offers and contracts: you prepare offer slides that make candidates excited to say yes, and you draft and manage employment contracts through to signature

  • Candidate experience: every applicant, hired or not, leaves with a good impression of Zeit AI. You own interview guides, scorecards and the debrief rhythm with the hiring team

  • Onboarding: contracts, equipment, accounts and a first week that never feels improvised

  • Payroll and benefits: you run payroll with Project B, handle benefits and insurance, and keep finance up to date on headcount and people costs

  • HR systems and data: you own our People tools and keep employee records accurate and secure. You pull the numbers the founders need, such as time-to-hire, pipeline health and headcount plans

  • Compliance: you keep contracts, policies and processes in line with German and UK employment law and know when to bring in external counsel

  • Visa and relocation: you guide international hires through work permits, visas and moving to Munich if needed

  • People processes: you design how we run feedback, performance conversations and the operating rhythm, together with the founders

  • Team and culture: you lead offsites, team events, the office

  • Automation: you find the repetitive work in People Ops and automate it rather than just documenting it

Your Skillset - what you bring to the table

  • 2+ years in People Operations, Recruiting, HR Generalist or Talent roles, ideally at a fast-growing startup or scale-up

  • Hands-on recruiting experience with an ATS. Ashby is a plus, but Greenhouse, Lever, Personio or similar count too

  • Solid working knowledge of German and UK employment law, contracts and payroll processes.

  • Very organised with real attention to detail. Contracts, payroll and candidate follow-ups are exactly where details matter

  • Excellent communication. You handle a senior candidate, a new joiner and a founder in the same afternoon and adjust for each

  • Strong ownership and a bias to action. You build the process when there isn't one yet

  • AI-native: you already use AI tools to work faster, and you're excited to automate People processes

  • German and English fluently

  • Munich, or ready to relocate. This role does not work remotely

What We Offer

  • Full trust, maximum support. Full trust, maximum support. You build the People function from scratch

  • Munich is our hub. In-person by design, and we cover your relocation within Europe

  • Regular team offsites

  • Best tools, zero blockers. Daily lunch allowance, dinner covered in the office, Wellpass

  • €5k referral bonus if we hire someone you refer

Join SE3 Labs as Staff Computer Vision Engineer - Perception

Take on SE3's hardest perception problems as a hands-on technical leader, and ship systems that work on real missions.

 

About SE3

SE3 Labs builds spatial intelligence and autonomy software for unmanned systems. We combine 3D computer vision, state estimation and AI to help autonomous platforms perceive their surroundings, know where they are and operate when GPS and other sensors become unreliable. Defence is a core application of our work today.

We are growing to a team of 100+ people. Join at a stage where you can shape our Perception team, help build the team and grow your responsibilities as the company expands.

Our founding team's research has received more than 90,000 citations. You will work closely with technical founders and engineers with deep experience in computer vision and autonomous systems, turning that research depth into systems that work in the field.

About the Role

As Staff Computer Vision Engineer - Perception, you'll set technical direction for SE3's perception stack across object detection, tracking, semantic segmentation and depth estimation, and spend around 80% of your time building it yourself. You'll work closely with our perception lead, founders and autonomy engineers, shaping architecture and core algorithmic decisions without people-management responsibility. Your work moves from recorded data to field trials and determines how well our platforms understand their surroundings.

 

What You’ll Work On

  • Architecture & Algorithms: Shape the architecture of the perception stack and drive core algorithmic decisions together with the team lead.

  • Detection & Tracking: Build object detection and multi-object tracking that stay reliable on real mission data.

  • Segmentation & Depth: Develop semantic segmentation and depth estimation that give downstream autonomy a dependable picture of the scene.

  • Evaluation & Replay: Design the evaluation and replay loop so the team iterates mostly on recorded data, with clear metrics, benchmark datasets and regression tests.

  • Real-World Deployment: Optimize models for onboard compute and take them through field trials until they work under real operating conditions.

  • Technical Roadmap: Contribute to the perception roadmap by identifying the problems that matter most for field performance.

  • Technical Leadership: Raise the engineering bar through design and code reviews, and mentor engineers by example.

     
 

Your Profile

  • You take ownership of hard problems and want to solve them hands-on, spending most of your time designing, coding and testing.

  • You hold a Ph.D. with 3+ years of industry experience, or an M.Sc. with 6+ years, in Computer Vision, Robotics, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering or a related field.

  • You have a proven record of building perception systems that shipped and worked in the real world, in robotics, autonomous driving, AR/VR, drones or adjacent domains.

  • You bring deep expertise across modern perception, including object detection, tracking, segmentation and depth estimation, and you base design decisions on evaluation data.

  • You lead through technical influence, setting direction, reviewing designs and helping others grow, without needing a management role.

  • You speak fluent English; German is a plus. Given the nature of SE3's work in the defence sector, candidates must be eligible to work on defence-related projects and, where required, obtain the relevant security clearance.

 

Especially Valued Bonus Skills

  • Publications at CVPR, ICCV, ECCV, NeurIPS or similar venues.

  • Contributions to well-used open-source computer vision or robotics projects.

  • Academic research or teaching experience alongside industry work.

  • Deploying models on real-time, resource-constrained compute such as Jetson-class platforms.

  • Field experience with UAVs or other robots that get tested outside the lab.

 

Perks & Benefits

  • Real Ownership: Participate in SE3’s growth through our employee participation programme

  • Work Environment to Excel at: Find a high-quality and modern toolset, flat hierarchy and a skilled, driven team which will push the limits together with you

  • AI-boosted workplace: We empower every employee with best-in-class AI tools and agents, giving you unlimited access to the latest advancements and a true productivity edge

  • 31 Paid Days Off: 30 vacation days plus your birthday off

  • Well-being Access: Free membership to gyms, yoga, and wellness through EGYM Wellpass

  • Team Offsites: We go on 2 company retreats per year, our last ones were in Italy and Greece

  • Mentorship: Work closely with experienced engineers and get paired with a professional mentor to support your growth

 

Our Process

  1. Intro Call (30 min): Let’s get to know each other

  2. Coding / Algorithm Interview: (90 min): We work through a practical perception, estimation, or robotics software problem together

  3. Technical Interview (1 hr): We dive into perception systems you have built and shipped, the hardest technical decisions you have made and how you raise the bar for a team.

  4. Team Dinner / Lunch: Meet the team and see whether it is a strong fit on both sides.

At OpenAI, we’re here to do something extraordinary: build safe AGI that benefits everyone. That mission demands people who are not just brilliant but also deeply aligned with our values. Our Recruiting team is the gateway connecting exceptional humans to meaningful, high-impact work. We’re a close-knit, mission-driven crew that takes pride in thoughtful, relationship-first hiring. We partner deeply with teams across OpenAI to find, engage, and support the people who will shape the future of AI.

About this Role

We’re looking for an experienced GTM Recruitment Sourcer to help identify, engage and attract exceptional talent across some of OpenAI’s most critical and rapidly growing teams, including Technical Solutions, Revenue Operations and Sales.


This is a high-impact role where you’ll play a key part in shaping our talent pipelines and building proactive sourcing strategies in competitive and evolving markets. You'll go beyond identifying candidates, developing a deep understanding of the talent landscape, uncovering exceptional talent and creating meaningful connections with people who could contribute to OpenAI's mission.


You'll partner closely with recruiters and hiring managers to translate hiring priorities into creative, data-informed sourcing strategies, bringing market intelligence and fresh perspectives to how we identify and engage talent.


You'll report to the regional recruiting lead and collaborate with recruiting colleagues and business stakeholders across our global organisation.

Your Responsibilities:

  • Partner closely with recruiters and hiring managers to understand business priorities, calibrate talent requirements and develop targeted sourcing strategies across GTM functions.

  • Proactively identify, engage and build relationships with exceptional talent, including passive candidates in highly competitive and emerging talent markets.

  • Build and maintain high-quality talent pipelines to support both immediate hiring priorities and longer-term workforce needs.

  • Develop creative, research-driven sourcing approaches, leveraging market mapping, talent intelligence, referrals, professional networks and emerging sourcing technologies.

  • Conduct initial candidate conversations to assess experience, motivations and alignment with role requirements, ensuring a thoughtful and engaging candidate experience.

  • Bring market insights to recruiting teams and hiring managers, including talent availability, competitive landscapes and emerging talent pools, to inform hiring strategies and challenge assumptions.

  • Partner with recruiters to continuously refine search strategies, evaluate pipeline quality and adapt approaches based on feedback and hiring outcomes.

  • Track sourcing activity and pipeline effectiveness, using data to identify opportunities to improve candidate engagement, quality and conversion.

  • Champion an inclusive approach to sourcing, exploring different backgrounds, experiences and talent pools to ensure we reach exceptional candidates who might otherwise be overlooked.

  • Experiment with AI-enabled sourcing tools and new technologies to improve sourcing effectiveness, efficiency and scalability, while maintaining strong human judgement.

  • Contribute to sourcing best practices, sharing market knowledge, creative approaches and insights with the wider recruiting organisation.

We're Seeking

  • 6+ years of experience in talent sourcing or recruiting, ideally within an in-house talent acquisition team or a high-growth, high-bar environment.

  • Experience sourcing for GTM functions such as Sales, Technical Success, Revenue Operations, Partnerships or User Operations.

  • A proven ability to identify and engage exceptional passive talent and build strong pipelines for complex or competitive roles.

  • Strong research and market-mapping skills, with the ability to uncover talent beyond traditional sourcing channels.

  • Sound talent judgement, with an ability to recognise both demonstrated experience and potential, and identify candidates who meet a high hiring bar.

  • A proactive and creative approach to sourcing, with the curiosity and persistence to explore new talent pools and experiment with different engagement strategies.

  • Excellent communication and relationship-building skills, with an ability to engage candidates authentically and create compelling narratives around career opportunities.

  • Strong collaboration and stakeholder management skills, with experience partnering closely with recruiters and hiring managers across different functions, regions and cultures.

  • A highly organised, execution-oriented approach, with the ability to manage multiple sourcing priorities while maintaining quality and attention to detail.

  • A data-informed mindset, using sourcing metrics, market insights and pipeline feedback to evaluate effectiveness and continuously improve outcomes.

  • Experience with modern recruiting and sourcing tools, such as Ashby and LinkedIn Recruiter, alongside an enthusiasm for leveraging AI and emerging technologies to find and engage talent.

data.description:
We're seeking a Staff Data Engineer to join one of the fastest-growing AI legal tech companies in Europe. You'll take technical ownership of the data platform behind how we run the business: the pipelines, the warehouse, and the definitions behind the numbers our leadership team actually uses.

You'll report to our Head of Engineering and work alongside a colleague who owns the business-facing side of data, plus our infrastructure and application engineers. This is a senior individual contributor role with no line management in either direction, roughly 70% hands-on building, 30% defining, documenting and explaining.

Your Challenge and Opportunity in This Role

JUPUS supports hundreds of law firms across Europe, and our customer base is growing roughly 4x a year. Our data platform has grown with it (ClickHouse, dbt, Python extract-load pipelines into an S3 data lake, orchestration in GitHub Actions) and it has grown fast.

Your job is to make it trustworthy. That means modernising what already exists, making historical trends a record of what actually happened rather than a nightly re-derivation of it, and owning the definitions behind the metrics that reach our board. This is not a greenfield build, and it is not a maintenance seat. It is a real platform with real problems, and you would own it.

Tasks

  • Own the data platform end to end: ingestion and the raw layer, the ClickHouse warehouse, and the dbt project on top of it. You're the person who can say whether a number is wrong or the pipeline is.

  • Make our numbers trustworthy: reliability, correctness, and a history that holds up, so that a trend is a record of what actually happened rather than a re-derivation of it.

  • Own the metrics the company runs on, starting with our customer health score- the definition, the denominator, the eligibility rules and the known limitations, not just the SQL underneath them.

  • Turn business questions into durable metrics: work directly with Customer Success, Sales, Product and leadership to understand what they're actually trying to decide, then build something defensible enough to decide on.

  • Keep cost and complexity in check as we grow: warehouse architecture, query cost, and the surfaces that deliver data into BI and our CRM. All of it gets harder as the customer base multiplies.

  • Set the standard for how data work is done here: one authoritative written definition per leadership-visible number, and the conventions that inform our Data function as it grows with us.

Requirements

Technical Expertise

  • Substantial experience in data engineering or analytics engineering, with production ownership of a warehouse and a transformation layer. We care more about evidence of ownership than about years served.

  • ClickHouse in production.

  • dbt at ownership level: incremental models, snapshots, tests, macros, CI/CD. Ideally you've inherited someone else's dbt project and left it better than you found it.

  • Python data engineering: EL tooling, S3, CI-based orchestration that you’ve owned end to end, with no platform team behind you.

  • Product event streams: PostHog, Amplitude, Segment, Mixpanel or similar. You understand how user-to-company identity and group association break, and what that does to every metric downstream.

Judgement and Ownership

  • You have defined a business KPI end to end and defended it to non-technical people. This is the differentiator for us. An excellent engineer who takes requirements as given is not the right fit for this role.

  • Analytical rigour: cohorts, correct denominators, sample size stated before findings. You'll say "we can't tell yet, and here's exactly why" rather than produce a confident chart.

  • You act without waiting for a ticket, and you can name something you chose to stop doing.

  • You're comfortable in front of senior stakeholders, including C-level, and can hold a technical line without losing the room.

Further Requirements

  • Located within CET +/-2.

  • Nice to have: BI tool administration (we use Metabase), CRM and billing systems as data sources, dlt specifically, GDPR-driven data deletion work, Grafana, German, or B2B SaaS and legal-tech domain experience.

  • Nice to have: you're used to non-technical colleagues querying data through AI tools, and you design for that.

Benefits

🎯 Metric Ownership – Own a business-critical metric end to end, definition included — not just the pipeline that feeds it.

🛠️ A Real Platform – ClickHouse and dbt already in production, with genuine problems worth solving. No greenfield theatre, no maintenance seat.

⚡ Direct Access – A flat structure and a direct line to our Head of Engineering, CTO and CEO. No committee between you and a decision.

📈 Growth Stage – Roughly 4x customer growth a year at one of Europe's fastest-growing AI legal tech companies.

🏡 Fully Remote – Enjoy the flexibility of working from anywhere

💻 Top Equipment – State-of-the-art MacBook plus all the accessories you need

🏋️ Wellbeing Perks – Urban Sports Club membership to support your healthy lifestyle

If you're excited about owning the numbers an AI startup runs on and delivering the data that guides us in our scaling journey, we'd love to hear from you.

As our Web & Visual Design Intern, you’ll work closely with our Founding Brand Operator, CEO, and GTM team to continuously build and improve Lio’s website. You’ll turn concepts and Figma designs into polished, responsive web experiences, while also bringing a strong visual eye to everything we put out.

This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys the intersection of web building, design, and technology and likes turning ideas into things that actually go live.

We’re open to both full-time candidates and freelancers for this role.


What You’ll Do

In this role, you will:

  • Build, launch, and continuously improve Lio’s website in Webflow or Framer

  • Work closely with our Founding Brand Operator, CEO, and GTM team to turn ideas and Figma designs into polished web experiences

  • Create responsive layouts, interactions, and animations that make the website feel polished across devices

Your Profile

You’ll thrive in this role if you:

  • Are highly comfortable building and shipping websites in Webflow or Framer

  • Have a strong visual eye for typography, layout, spacing, and composition

  • Can take a rough idea or Figma concept and turn it into a polished live experience

Your experience can come from professional, freelance, or personal projects — what matters most to us is what you can build.

At Lio, you’ll help build the next category-defining AI company from the ground up. You’ll work closely with our Founding Brand Operator, CEO, and GTM team and see the things you build go live quickly.

The Opportunity

AI is fundamentally changing how enterprises operate.

As AI agents become capable of executing increasingly complex workflows, enterprise customers expect more than presentations—they want to see working solutions inside their own environments.

At Lio, we're building THE AI workforce for procurement.

As a Sales Engineer, you're not just supporting sales.

You're helping some of the world's largest enterprises understand what's technically possible with AI. You'll build prototypes, lead technical workshops, and work closely with customers to turn complex requirements into working software that proves real business value.

What You'll Do

In this role, you will:

  • Build prototypes, proof-of-concepts, and custom solutions that demonstrate the value of our platform

  • Configure and adapt Lio's AI platform to customer workflows and enterprise system landscapes

  • Lead technical deep dives, live demos, and workshops with procurement, IT, and architecture teams

  • Partner closely with Sales throughout the entire enterprise sales process as the technical expert

  • Collaborate with Product and Engineering to translate recurring customer needs into scalable product capabilities

Your Profile

Lio is backed by Andreessen Horowitz (a16z) and built at Y Combinator. We're bringing Silicon Valley ambition and speed to Munich while building one of Europe's leading AI companies.

Über Buena

Buena baut die Technologie, auf der die Immobilienbranche läuft. Wir machen jeden Teil der Immobilienwirtschaft so nahtlos und transparent wie möglich, vom Finden über das Finanzieren bis zum Verwalten.

Dafür übernehmen wir Hausverwaltungen in ganz Deutschland und bauen sie zu Technologieunternehmen um. In den letzten drei Jahren sind wir mit weniger als 30 Leuten im HQ zu Deutschlands zweitgrößtem Immobilienverwalter geworden.

Über die Rolle

Du kennst den Alltag einer Hausverwaltung und weißt, wie du Ordnung reinbringst, wenn Abläufe stocken, Aufgaben liegen bleiben oder Verantwortlichkeiten unklar sind.

Genau dort setzt du bei Buena an. Jeden Monat übernehmen wir neue Hausverwaltungen, und du überführst sie in den Buena-Betrieb. Deine Basis ist unser Büro in Berlin, deine Einsätze finden in unseren Verwaltungen in ganz Deutschland statt. Dein Erfolg zeigt sich in funktionierenden Abläufen und in Teams, die mit der Buena App besser arbeiten als vorher.

Verantwortlichkeiten

  • Du arbeitest im Tagesgeschäft unserer Verwaltungen mit, erkennst Engpässe früh und baust Rückstände ab. Vor und nach der Umstellung auf die Buena App.

  • Du schaffst mit den Teams klare Zuständigkeiten und Prozesse, die auch nach deinem Einsatz Bestand haben.

  • Du kennst unsere Software in- und auswendig und trainierst die Teams an ihren konkreten Aufgaben.

  • Du bringst deine Erfahrungen aus dem Verwaltungsalltag zurück ins Product-Team. Was du vor Ort siehst, macht unsere App besser.

Du passt gut, wenn du

  • Mehrjährige praktische Erfahrung in der Immobilienverwaltung mitbringst und das Tagesgeschäft eigenständig beherrschst.

  • Probleme schnell erkennst, Prioritäten setzt und selbst mit anpackst.

  • Klar kommunizierst, schnell Vertrauen aufbaust und Menschen für neue Arbeitsweisen gewinnst.

  • Tech-affin bist. Neue Software lernst du schnell und erklärst sie so, dass anderen die Arbeit leichter fällt.

  • Bereit bist, regelmäßig bei unseren Verwaltungen in ganz Deutschland vor Ort zu arbeiten, je nach Einsatz auch mehrere Tage am Stück.

  • Fließend Deutsch sprichst.

Deine Benefits

  • Bis zu 500 € Close-to-Office-Bonus, wenn du 10 bis 20 Gehminuten vom Büro entfernt wohnst.

  • 110 €/Monat Lunch-Budget, 50 € Fitness-Zuschuss.

  • 1.200 € jährliches Weiterbildungsbudget.

  • Kostenlose Bücher: Buena zahlt jedes Buch, das du lesen möchtest.

Warum jetzt einsteigen

  • Du bist die Person vor Ort: Jede Verwaltung, die wir übernehmen, wird erst durch dich zu einem Buena-Betrieb. Ohne dich bleibt sie, was sie war.

  • Wir wachsen schnell: Jeden Monat kommen neue Hausverwaltungen dazu. Deine Einsätze werden nicht weniger, sondern größer.

  • Wir sind meritokratisch: Wer liefert, bekommt Verantwortung. Unser CEO war vor drei Jahren Junior Product Manager, unser COO vor zwei Jahren Chief of Staff.

  • Wir verändern eine ganze Branche: Die deutsche Hausverwaltung läuft noch auf Papier und Excel. Du stellst das vor Ort um.

data.description:
Let’s shoot for the stars:
We are seeking a driven and analytically strong (Senior) Manager FP&A (m/f/d) to join our Finance team at Limehome. Reporting directly to the Head of Corporate Finance & FP&A, you'll strengthen our financial stewardship across budgeting, planning, analysis, reporting, and business partnering - building the analytical rigor and automation that enable confident decision-making as we scale. On an ad-hoc basis, you'll also support Corporate Finance initiatives around fundraising, debt financing, and M&A when business priorities require.

How you’ll be hosting with heart:

Budgeting, Planning & Analysis

  • Support the annual budgeting and forecasting process, ensuring bottom-up planning is executed with rigor and on schedule

  • Prepare and analyze consolidated cash flow forecasts to deepen our understanding of liquidity needs and spending patterns

  • Build and maintain property-level and business-line analysis, ensuring leadership has the financial insights needed for informed decisions

Financial Reporting & Automation

  • You'll be accountable for the accuracy and timeliness of investor reporting deliverables, ensuring compliance with lender and investor requirements

  • Identify and implement reporting automation opportunities, reducing manual effort and improving data validation across the finance function

  • Support the development and maintenance of reusable reporting templates and frameworks


Business Partnering 

  • Cooperate with key stakeholders across the organization for regular business reviews, analyzing financial performance against plan and identifying key variance drivers

  • Support financial analysis and strategic investigations, providing data-driven insights to inform investment decisions across the company

  • Contribute to the preparation and maintenance of financial dashboards and executive commentary on key performance indicators for the leadership team

Treasury & Risk Management

  • Contribute to the evaluation and implementation of treasury software solutions, optimizing cash management tooling and automation across entities

  • Prepare and maintain intra-group fund flows and cash arrangements

  • Assist with the analysis and management of foreign exchange and interest rate exposures, contributing to risk mitigation strategies and hedging recommendations


What you need to shoot for the stars:

  • 3+ years of progressive experience in FP&A, Treasury, controlling, or comparable analytical finance roles, ideally in high-growth or scaling environments

  • Strong financial modeling and analytical capabilities, combined with thorough attention to detail, structured process thinking, and pragmatic problem-solving approach

  • Demonstrated understanding of financial statement analysis and key performance indicators relevant to business stewardship

  • Hands-on proficiency with reporting, business intelligence, or enterprise performance management tools; ability to work effectively with large datasets and commitment to process automation

  • Structured, accountability-focused working approach with demonstrated ability to operate independently and deliver consistently against commitments

  • Strong interpersonal and communication capabilities, with demonstrated effectiveness in cross-functional and external stakeholder engagement

  • Excellent command of English (business fluent); proficiency in German is advantageous

We're designed to stay because:

  • Hybrid Office Model: We offer a flexible and empowering work environment - you can choose to work 100% from our office or partially from home and the office.

  • Visa & Language Support: We’ll support you during your visa process and with learning German on every language level after passing your probation period.

  • Relocation Support: We'll financially support your move to Munich if you live further away than 300km from our office.

  • Oneteam: We are #oneteam with a transparent company culture by staying up to date with each other through team stand-ups, regular All-Hands and suite events (Summer, Wiesn, Christmas).

  • Growth and Development: We make sure that you keep growing - through constant feedback, peer reviews and exchanges with focus on your development.

  • Limitless learning: We offer you the possibility to choose an external development format that will help you in reaching your full potential without any limits in budget.

  • Workation: You have the chance to work twice per year for a duration of up to 4 weeks from a different country in the European Union. Our Limehomies love traveling so we want to give them the chance to work from inspiring new locations regularly.

  • Sabbatical: After your 1.5 years with Limehome we offer the possibility for a 3-month sabbatical. You can use it for whatever you want: may it be traveling, spending time with your besties or volunteering.

  • Everything for our Limehomies: We focus on your physical wellbeing (Urban Sports Club), to your mental wellbeing (Nilo.health), or even staycations in one of our beautiful Limehomes, and many more suite benefits. Join us and find out! 😉

Who we are:

Limehome is a leading tech-enabled operator in the hospitality industry offering functional, design accommodations across Europe. Using proprietary technology, Limehome delivers comfortable and convenient stays with a seamless digital guest experience for business and leisure travellers. Our vision is to be the first choice in travel for everyone, everywhere. By now, our portfolio consists of more than 10,000 apartments and hotel rooms under contract across 150 cities in 13 European countries.
